Rust_interface.GPU: feature render; material_renderer::{Renderer,GpuScene,wgpu}; Renderer::new(&Device,target_format), upload(&Device,&Queue,&RenderScene), GpuScene::set_frame(&Queue,&Frame), Renderer::draw(&GpuScene,&mut caller RenderPass)
Rust_interface.ownership: Caller owns Device, Queue, Encoder, targets and render pass. Each GpuScene owns its frame buffer. No adapter/window/eventloop in library. Frame updates change GPU memory only; no Editor/MCP/file writes.
Rust_interface.memory: validate_bytes(raw descriptor, expected SHA, all encoded resources) before prepare. Render packet borrows immutable validated project; GPU copies checked decoded RGBA8. No filesystem access in prepare/upload/draw.

geometry.source: Complete pinned bb025 source, native polygon tessellation corner-index mapping and source triangles. All authored faces; no LOD/face filtering or editing selection overlays. Any tessellation diagnostics fail. Source fields and raw bytes retained; packet is derived only.
geometry.per_corner_UV: Index the original polygon/triangle corner UVs; never index by shared vertex. GPU storesf32; native f64 source remains unchanged. Native physical world transforms including parent inverse applied once.
geometry.materials: Entity override before slot. Bound image uses declared layer; unbound native material is solid base color with an internal white texel. Missing declared image/UV fails. Opaque unlit first profile: used alpha must equal1; no PBR/normal/light evaluation.

fixed_inputs.mutations: None to original panel/PNG/manifest. Gray/factor diagnostics use separately hashed disposable copies.

render.model_to_world: identity at baseline; runtime frame matrix allowed without source writes
render.color_target: Rgba8UnormSrgb; Bgra8UnormSrgb supported with explicit readback swizzle

color.image: EncodedRGB8 expandedtoRGBA8 alpha255; GPUtextureRgba8UnormSrgb, one mip. sRGBsample->linear once.
color.material_factor: Native base_color RGB treatedaslinear normalized factor; alpha1. Multiply after image decode. Untextured materials use linear native factor.
color.output: Linear shader color -> sRGB render target encode once. No tone mapping/exposure/lights/PBR/dither.

pixel_rules.tolerance: EveryRGBAchannel CPU/GPUandgolden absdifference<=1codevalue; no aggregate score can hide a failed pixel.
pixel_rules.gray: SeparateRGB8gray128 image, white native factor; output128 alpha255 andCPUlinear0.21586050011389926 abs<=1e-12.
pixel_rules.factor: Separategray128 image withnative RGBfactor0.5, alpha1; expectedoutput92 alpha255. Separatefullred255 withRGBfactor0.5 expected188. Originalwhitefactorcaseunchanged.

external_consumer.gpu_build: --features gpu; runtime still requires explicit --gpu. Caller requests actual Metal backend without fallback, owns all GPU objects, reads raw output, validates scopes and records adapter/backend/source/shader/image/frame/hash/wait/exit.
external_consumer.execution: NOT authorized inRoot or CI. External consumer is compile-checked only. Ashfall performs independently admitted Metal run after fixed source/API/protocol delivery.

checks_before_delivery: Explicit pure CPU geometry tests and Naga WGSL parse/validation without a GPU
CPU and GPU-feature external consumer cargo check under pinned lockfiles
ExistingCI unchanged gates retained; no new GPU/device/window test run
Source/encodedresource hashes before/after; source remains editable/native; no replacement by render triangles
